role: Reads the frame buffer with glGetTexImage/glReadPixels and writes a timestamped PNG under screenshots/, returning a chat message with the file name.
notes: Screenshots are a human-client feature. The native engine's frames are written by the replay harness (out/java/frames and the pixel gates), never through this path; F2 is not bound in the native player client. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: F2 screenshots: reads the frame buffer and writes a PNG; no game state, and native frames are written by the harness.
